errors.evidence: This does not describe the axis scale, which starts at 0.0. Instead, it seems to be an incorrect attempt to describe the range of the data.
The labeled tick marks on the y-axis are at 0.0, 0.3, and 0.6, indicating a major tick interval of 0.3, not 0.05.
The chart clearly shows four groups of two bars each, resulting in four blue bars and four green bars, not five and three.
The approximate values for the blue bars at ranks 16, 64, and 256 are 0.25, 0.35, and 0.68, respectively, not the values stated.
This list omits the green bar present at the rank of 4, which has a value of approximately 0.20.
The approximate values for the green bars at ranks 16, 64, and 256 are 0.08, 0.18, and 0.65, respectively. The reported values are all significantly incorrect.
The description fails to mention the grouped structure of the chart, where each rank on the x-axis has a pair of associated bars (one blue and one green).
The description completely omits the black error bars that are present on top of every bar in the chart.
